scope:
Natural-K4 nonzero-fill cancellation and complete fixed integer continuation.
Same Machine runs source gate reads -> full U -> RNE/sat -> F/raw merge -> gate
and U24/V96/PED including nonanchor gate and real gate/PED egress. Source PSN,
preview, native projection convolution and global BN remain outside this scope.

consumer_report.input_contract: Each raw I24 pixel is 2880 contiguous bytes, spatial/T/C order; source-side packing not covered.
consumer_report.common_baseline: Direct V completion, actual V24 spill for post-BN reread.

rows.new_datapath: 8 lane-local 3-bit operands select n-e or1bit; existing 16x24 multiply width; no additional RF read. Physical mux area/timing unmeasured.
